transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We have a hotline allegation regarding procurement personnel accepting improper benefits from a supplier, and the audit committee expects an approved investigation charter by end of week. Before we draft and approve that charter, I need to follow our standard practice: I'd like a brief status from investigations counsel and compliance on any relevant case or intake information. Once we have that, we can agree on and record the charter terms before we wrap up today. Who would like to start?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Before we proceed, I need to flag a critical issue. I completed the conflicts check on Westbridge Investigations this morning and found that its lead investigator represented the procurement vice president in a prior personal matter. The conflict register hasn't been updated yet. We need to use the approved alternate firm, Barton & Vale, instead. Additionally, because Elena approved the procurement vice president's compensation last year, the investigation must report directly to the audit committee rather than to Elena, to preserve independence.
transcript.speaker: A2
